title: Notifications people do not turn off
summary: Send many teams' notifications through one service that respects each person's limits and choices.
context: Hoodi Hops has ten teams that each send push, SMS and email directly. A person can get eleven messages in a day, and uninstalls have risen. SMS costs real money, and one mistaken campaign last month cost several lakh rupees.
An order update must always arrive. A promotion can wait until morning or never go at all.
must_handle: A person's choices are honoured across every team and channel.
A person gets no more than a set number of promotional messages a day.
An order update goes out at once, whatever the promotions are doing.
A message is not sent at 3 am unless it is urgent.
A mistaken campaign can be stopped midway, and its cost is capped.
show_in_answer: The path of a message from a team to a phone.
How urgent and promotional traffic are kept apart.
Where preferences and daily counts live, and how they are checked.
